title: Week 14 Secure Exchange Sequence
description: Ordered sender, receiver, authentication, encryption, authorization, replay control, audit, and safe rejection behavior.

diagrams.title: Authenticated Envelope Creation Acceptance and Replay Rejection
diagrams.accessibility: A coordinator signs in and requests an envelope for a consultation. Laravel authorizes the role and assignment, minimizes the record, and asks OpenSSL AES 256 GCM to encrypt it using a key from the ignored keyring. The adviser signs in and submits the envelope. Laravel authenticates the envelope and adviser, stores one unique replay receipt, and returns plaintext. A second submission is rejected with conflict and is audited without plaintext.
